clips.title: The story
paras: Apothecary Renferrel sends you to gather rare reagents across Lake Lordamere. Berard's journal names mosses and a strange tumor, which you bring to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity. The Royal Apothecary Society needs them for its work on a New Plague.

Apothecary Berard's death under Arugal's curse cost the Royal Apothecary Society a skilled researcher. His field journal survived, preserving what he learned about blighted life in Silverpine Forest and Lake Lordamere. At the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel studied the recovered notes and found Berard's account of promising properties in local freshwater organisms. Now Renferrel asks you to carry forward the work his colleague began.

Berard's reagents lie among the Dawning Isles, mist-shrouded islands in the eastern waters of Lake Lordamere. Lake skulkers and lake creepers on the isles carry peculiar moss strains that live in tainted water. Berard also noted a hardened tumor among the fierce Vile Fin murloc tribes that nest along the islets and the lake's southern shoreline near Ambermill.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: According to Berard's Journal the moss from Lake Skulkers and Creepers might prove useful for our quest to brew a new plague. Those beasts dwell on the islands in Lake Lordamere to the east.
He also mentions a very rare Hardened Tumor that he discovered on a Vile Fin murloc. Apparently the tumor is so rare Berard was only able to obtain one.
Collect samples of the moss as well as the rare hardened tumor and take them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What brings you back to the Undercity, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Such a blow to the Royal Apothecary Society to lose Berard. But through your hard work and Apothecary Renferrel's diligent research Berard's studies will still be useful to The Dark Lady's plight.
We are on the cusp of something great here, friend. If you were not so skilled in the ways of combat I would try to recruit you for membership in the Society.
